headline: 4 Dividend Kings Almost Nobody Talks About
summary: Most income investors can name Coca-Cola and Procter & Gamble as Dividend Kings, but four quiet compounders with 50-plus years of consecutive increases keep flying under the radar, including one gas utility on a streak that dwarfs nearly every name in the group.
